## Overview

Brazilian states with occurrence evidence for **`r taxon`** from
`r paste(setdiff(d$source_summary$Source, "FFB (official)"), collapse = ", ")` were compared
against the states officially listed for this taxon in the
[Flora e Funga do Brasil (FFB)](https://floradobrasil.jbrj.gov.br/consulta/) distribution,
to flag **candidate new state records**.
`r if (!identical(d$ffb_name, d$taxon)) paste0("In FFB, ", d$taxon, " is a synonym of *", d$ffb_name, "*, whose distribution was used.") else ""`
`r if (!isTRUE(d$ffb_found)) paste0("**", d$taxon, " was not found in the current FFB checklist**, so every state with records is flagged.") else if (d$n_in_ffb == 0) paste0("**FFB lists no Brazilian state for *", d$ffb_name, "*** (as for some marine algae), so every state with records is flagged.") else ""`
`r if (!is.na(d$gbif_name)) paste0("GBIF records were matched to *", d$gbif_name, "*, including its synonyms and infraspecific taxa.") else ""`

`r if (isTRUE(d$domains_run)) "Georeferenced records were also placed on IBGE's map of the six Brazilian phytogeographic domains, to flag **candidate new domain records**, shown on a map below." else ""`

Occurrence records are evidence to review, not proof: a record from a new state or domain
may be a cultivated plant, a misidentification, or a georeferencing error. The individual
records behind each candidate are listed in this report.

```{r kpi-boxes}
htmltools::tags$div(
  class = "kpi-row",
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-green",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value", comma(d$n_in_ffb)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label", "States already in FFB distribution")
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-gold",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value", comma(d$n_states_total)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label", "States with any evidence")
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-red",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value", comma(d$n_new_candidates)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label", "New state record candidates")
  )
)
```

## Evidence by Source

```{r table-source}
src <- d$source_summary

DT::datatable(
  src,
  colnames = c("Source", "States with evidence", "Records"),
  rownames = FALSE,
  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
    style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
    "Table 1. Number of states and records with evidence, by source."
  ),
  options = list(pageLength = 5, dom = "t")
) %>%
  DT::formatStyle("States",
                  background = DT::styleColorBar(src$States, "#EEF6EC"),
                  backgroundSize = "98% 88%",
                  backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
                  backgroundPosition = "center")
```

## Complete State-by-State Table

The table below lists every Brazilian state with evidence for **`r taxon`**, flagging
`New_state_record_candidate = TRUE` for states with occurrence evidence that are not yet
in FFB's official distribution. Use the column filters to narrow the list, and the
buttons above the table to copy or download it as CSV/Excel.

```{r table-states}
tbl <- d$result

DT::datatable(
  tbl,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = list(position = "top", clear = TRUE, plain = FALSE),
  extensions = c("Buttons"),
  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
    style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
    paste0("Table 2. All ", comma(nrow(tbl)),
           " state(s) with evidence for ", taxon, ".")
  ),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 30,
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
    scrollX = TRUE,
    search = list(regex = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE)
  )
) %>%
  DT::formatStyle(
    "New_state_record_candidate",
    backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(c(TRUE, FALSE), c("#fde8ea", "#EEF6EC"))
  )
```

## Phytogeographic Domains

```{r domains-intro, results = "asis"}
if (!isTRUE(d$domains_run)) {
  cat("The phytogeographic domain analysis was not run (it requires the **sf** package,",
      "and `domains = TRUE`).\n")
} else {
  cat("Each georeferenced record was placed in one of the six Brazilian phytogeographic",
      "domains using IBGE's biome map (2019) bundled with floraR, and the domains with",
      "records were compared against those FFB lists for", paste0("**", taxon, "**"),
      paste0("(", if (length(d$ffb_domains)) paste(d$ffb_domains, collapse = ", ") else "none", ")."),
      "Only GBIF records without geospatial issues are used (up to",
      format(d$max_coordinates, big.mark = ","), "records). A record close to a domain",
      "boundary deserves a closer look before it is counted as a new domain record.\n")
}
```

```{r kpi-domains}
if (isTRUE(d$domains_run)) {
  htmltools::tags$div(

}
```

## Map of Georeferenced Records

```{r map, out.height = "560px"}
# Only records within the six domains are mapped
recs <- d$coord_records
recs <- recs[!is.na(recs$Domain), , drop = FALSE]
if (!isTRUE(d$domains_run) || nrow(recs) == 0) {
  htmltools::p("No georeferenced records within the phytogeographic domains to map.", style = "color: #6c757d; font-style: italic;")
} else if (!requireNamespace("leaflet", quietly = TRUE)) {
  htmltools::p("Install the leaflet package to see the map of records.",
               style = "color: #6c757d; font-style: italic;")
} else {
  domains_map <- sf::st_transform(readRDS(system.file("extdata", "br_domains.rds",
                                                      package = "floraR")), 4326)
  # The FFB domain palette (as in the FFB domain richness map)
  domain_fill <- c("Amazônia" = "#357A6C", "Caatinga" = "#3967B9", "Cerrado" = "#A55F20",
                   "Mata Atlântica" = "#744DAC", "Pampa" = "#B54750", "Pantanal" = "#667621")
  status <- ifelse(recs$New_domain_record_candidate, "New domain record candidate",
            ifelse(recs$New_state_record_candidate, "New state record candidate",
                   "Within FFB distribution"))
  # Marker colours absent from the domain palette, so records stand out on it
  status_col <- c("New domain record candidate" = "#FFD60A",
                  "New state record candidate" = "#FF4040",
                  "Within FFB distribution" = "#BDBDBD")
  esc <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(ifelse(is.na(x), "", x))
  popup <- paste0("<b>", esc(recs$Identified_as), "</b><br>",
                  esc(recs$RecordedBy), " ", esc(recs$RecordNumber), " (", esc(recs$EventDate), ")<br>",
                  esc(recs$Institution), " ", esc(recs$CatalogNumber), "<br>",
                  esc(recs$State), " - ", esc(recs$Domain), "<br><i>", status, "</i><br>",
                  ifelse(grepl("^https?://", recs$RecordLink),
                         paste0('<a href="', recs$RecordLink, '" target="_blank">',
                                recs$RecordLink, '</a>'), ""))
  # Candidates are drawn last, so they sit on top
  ord <- order(match(status, rev(names(status_col))))
  leaflet::leaflet(width = "100%") |>
    leaflet::addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") |>  # basemap needing no API key
    leaflet::addPolygons(data = domains_map, weight = 1, color = "#ffffff",
                         fillColor = unname(domain_fill[domains_map$domain]), fillOpacity = 0.85,
                         label = domains_map$domain) |>
    leaflet::addCircleMarkers(lng = recs$Longitude[ord], lat = recs$Latitude[ord],
                              radius = ifelse(status[ord] == "Within FFB distribution", 4, 6),
                              stroke = TRUE, weight = 1.2, color = "#1B1B1B",
                              fillColor = unname(status_col[status[ord]]), fillOpacity = 0.9,
                              popup = popup[ord]) |>
    leaflet::addLegend("bottomright", colors = unname(status_col), labels = names(status_col),
                       title = "Records", opacity = 0.9) |>
    leaflet::addLegend("bottomleft", colors = unname(domain_fill), labels = names(domain_fill),
                       title = "Phytogeographic domains", opacity = 1)
}
```

## Records in Candidate Domains

The georeferenced records that fall in a phytogeographic domain not yet in FFB's
distribution for **`r taxon`**, each linking to the record in its source database.

```{r table-domain-records}
recs <- d$coord_records
recs <- recs[recs$New_domain_record_candidate, , drop = FALSE]
if (!isTRUE(d$domains_run) || nrow(recs) == 0) {
  htmltools::p("No georeferenced record falls in a domain outside FFB's distribution.",
               style = "color: #6c757d; font-style: italic;")
} else {
  recs$RecordLink <- ifelse(
    !is.na(recs$RecordLink) & grepl("^https?://", recs$RecordLink),
    paste0('<a href="', recs$RecordLink, '" target="_blank">', recs$RecordLink, '</a>'),
    ifelse(is.na(recs$RecordLink), "", recs$RecordLink)
  )
  recs$Taxon <- NULL
  DT::datatable(
    recs,
    rownames = FALSE,
    escape = FALSE,
    filter = list(position = "top", clear = TRUE, plain = FALSE),
    extensions = c("Buttons"),
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
      paste0("Table 4. ", comma(nrow(recs)),
             " georeferenced record(s) in candidate new domains for ", taxon, ".")
    ),
    options = list(pageLength = 20, dom = "Bfrtip", buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
                   scrollX = TRUE)
  )
}
```

## Individual Records for the New State Candidates

Unlike the state-level table above, this table lists the individual occurrence records
found in Brazilian states that are not yet in FFB's official distribution for
**`r taxon`** (up to 50 GBIF records per state), each linking to the record in its
source database.

```{r table-records}
recs <- d$records_detail

if (is.null(recs) || nrow(recs) == 0) {
  htmltools::p(
    "No individual records were retrieved for the new-state-record candidates ",
    "(there may be no candidates, or no record-level source among 'sources').",
    style = "color: #6c757d; font-style: italic;"
  )
} else {
  recs$RecordLink <- ifelse(
    !is.na(recs$RecordLink) & grepl("^https?://", recs$RecordLink),
    paste0('<a href="', recs$RecordLink, '" target="_blank">', recs$RecordLink, '</a>'),
    ifelse(is.na(recs$RecordLink), "", recs$RecordLink)
  )

  DT::datatable(
    recs,
    rownames = FALSE,
    escape = FALSE,
    filter = list(position = "top", clear = TRUE, plain = FALSE),
    extensions = c("Buttons"),
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
      paste0("Table 5. ", comma(nrow(recs)),
             " individual record(s) from the new-state-record candidates for ", taxon, ".")
    ),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 20,
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
      scrollX = TRUE,
      search = list(regex = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
      lengthMenu = list(c(10, 20, 50, 100, -1),
                        c("10", "20", "50", "100", "All"))
    )
  )
}
```
